title: Calibration Chamber
coordinate_convention: [row, column], zero-based; map rows are listed top to bottom
design_notes: Construction and physical unlocking are separate. Start in |00> with no prepared gates. Alice places H(q0), then Bob places CX(q0,q1); Bob owns the placement terminal, not the control qubit. RUN CIRCUIT checks the ordered preparation and the target Phi+ modulo global phase. Measurements are blocked until that validation, and both physical doors remain closed until both explicit results match. Both 00 and 11 open both doors; local open_on bits are deliberately absent. RUN CIRCUIT validates locally against the precomputed reference and never submits another backend job. Classical debugger communication is required; entanglement does not send a message.
integration_notes: 10 physical entities: two players, two sensors, two gate terminals, two doors and two exits. Add a RUN CIRCUIT UI button bound to engine.run_circuit(); disable sensors until measurement_enabled and drive collision/door art from door_states. The Bob-owned CX terminal activates from Bob's room and is not the shared two-player terminal used in L3. Reachable exits are behind their respective physical doors; JS still confirms both players at exits.

narration.enter:
Build H on Alice, then Bob's CX.
Doors stay locked until you run.
narration.first_gate:
Place H first, then CX(0,1).
RUN CIRCUIT checks the Bell state.
narration.validation_failed:
Circuit not ready: use H, then CX.
Reset the stage and try again.
narration.circuit_validated:
Bell state verified. Doors stay shut.
Measure both qubits to unlock them.
narration.first_measure:
You measured one qubit.
Both results must match to unlock.
narration.death:
No exit yet: complete the protocol.
Reset and prepare the Bell pair.
narration.glitch:
Backend data disagrees with ideal.
See the sampling diagnostics.
narration.win:
Bell verified; matching bits measured.
Both doors are open. Reach the exits.
